data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: Can students pay a different price from guests?
Set up separate events or ask applicants who they are; the price they see is the price they pay, by UPI or card.
Can our volunteers run the door?
Yes. Give each volunteer door access for one event, on their own phone. It ends with the event.
What happens when the committee changes?
Your page, followers, events and records stay. Add next year’s team and take the old team’s access away.
Our events are mostly free. Is that OK?
Yes. Free events stay free. You pay 5% only on tickets sold, and never more than ₹10,000 a month.
No. They book, pay and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.
Can alumni chapters in different cities use it?
Yes. Each meetup is its own event on your page. Book a walkthrough and we’ll help you set up the chapters.
